title: Weird occurrence at the school last night
content: I was back in the school area last night. It started out the same as usual. Only consisted of me wandering around looking for my classes and feeling out of place in every single one I found. The weird occurrence started when I thought I finally found the class I belonged in. For the first time in years of having those dreams. I felt a huge sense of relief. But, of course, SOMETHING had to go wrong and take away my peace. Just as I was unpacking my things and getting settled into my chair, this tall brunette lady in high heels suddenly bursts into the room and angrily drags me out by my ear all the way into what I assume was her office while everyone else was staring at us with a shocked look. Once we got into her office, she immediately began berating me about how “I shouldn’t hack into school systems thinking nobody would find out” or some BS like that. I had absolutely no clue what she was blabbering about. A few minutes later, she had to leave her office to do something and I took that as my chance to escape. I don’t usually leave the school but I felt weirdly obligated to this time. When I got outside, I first spotted what looked like a giant dollhouse. There was an elderly lady walking around inside. I tried to call out to her but I literally couldn’t speak, so my only choice was to get in there myself. But before I could get to the entrance of the dollhouse, I suddenly felt like gravity was weighing me down 100x stronger than normal. I also suddenly felt this huge energy behind me [difficult to explain how. it was like a huge pressure] so I looked behind me to see what was going on and there was a giant feral-looking squirrel with a huge evil grin on its face towering over me. That was thankfully right when I woke up in a cold sweat. What the fuck was that?
